CLAREMONT CITY COUNCIL
  MEETING AGENDA
  “We are a vibrant, livable, and inclusive community dedicated to quality services,
  safety, financial strength, sustainability, preservation, and progress
  with equal representation for our community.”

City Council Chamber  Tuesday
225 Second Street  July 23, 2024
Claremont, CA 91711
  6:30 PM

  COUNCILMEMBERS

  SAL MEDINA
  MAYOR

  JED LEANO  ED REECE  COREY CALAYCAY  JENNIFER STARK

Meetings are open to the public for in-person attendance. The meeting will be live streamed via Zoom,
technology permitting. Members of the public will not be able to provide public comment via Zoom. To
watch the meeting via Zoom, use the following link: https://zoom.us/j/256208090. To listen via telephone
dial (213) 338-8477, Webinar ID: 256 208 090. The recorded meeting will be uploaded to the City
website and archived.

  OPTIONS FOR PUBLIC COMMENT

Public comment may be provided by one of the following methods. Each speaker will be given up to
three (3) minutes to provide their comment.

  IN-PERSON LIVE COMMENTS

When the item you wish to speak to is announced, please proceed to the speaker’s podium one by one.

  E-MAIL/MAIL

Written comments sent to the City Clerk’s office will be distributed to the City Council and imaged into
the record of the meeting. Email: sdesautels@ci.claremont.ca.us, jcostanza@ci.claremont.ca.us. Mail:
PO Box 880, Claremont, CA 91711. Written comments submitted after publication of the agenda will be
made available in the document archive system on the City website as soon as possible -
www.ci.claremont.ca.us.

  For assistance, comments, or more information please contact the City Clerk’s Office:
  (909) 399-5461 or (909) 399-5463.

MAYOR AND COUNCIL

Council Items
1.  APPOINTMENT OF MEMBERS TO CITY COMMISSIONS AND COMMITTEES
  Recommendation:  The City Council Ad Hoc Selection Committee recommends the City Council
  make the following appointments:

  Architectural and Preservation Commission
  Lisa Castillo for a term to expire August 31, 2028
  John Neiuber for a term to expire August 31, 2026

  Community and Human Services Commission
  Dirk Silva for a term to expire August 31, 2027

  Police Commission
  Tim Dunfee for a term to expire August 31, 2028
  Aundre Johnson for a term to expire August 31, 2026
  Vickie Noble for a term to expire August 31, 2028

  Traffic and Transportation Commission
  Dylan Arya for a term to expire August 31, 2028

  Sustainability Committee
  Katie Distelrath for a term to expire January 31, 2028

  Public Art Committee
  Maureen Wheeler for a term to expire August 31, 2028
2.  DESIGNATION OF VOTING DELEGATE FOR THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY TO BE HELD AT
  THE LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES ANNUAL CONFERENCE AND EXPO
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council designate a voting delegate and one or
  two alternate voting delegates for the League of California Cities 2024
  Conference and Expo General Assembly meeting to be held on October 18,
  2024.
  Attachment(s):  Voting Delegate Packet

Council Assignment Reports
City Councilmembers may serve as representatives on regional organizations. This time is
allocated for reports about their activities. For information about the Council's local,
intergovernmental  and  regional  appointments  please  visit  the  City website :
www.ci.claremont.ca.us/government/city-council/city-council-assignments-and-appointments.

CITY MANAGER REPORT
 Page 4  City Council Agenda  July 23, 2024

PUBLIC COMMENT
The Council has set aside this time for persons who wish to comment on items that are not listed
on the agenda, but are within the jurisdiction of the City Council. Members of the public will have
the opportunity to address the City Council regarding all items on the agenda at the time the
Council considers those items.

General public comment will be taken for 30 minutes and will resume later in the meeting if there
are speakers who did not get an opportunity to speak because of the 30-minute time limit.

The Brown Act prohibits the City Council from taking action on oral requests relating to items that
are not on the agenda. The Council may engage in a brief discussion, refer the matter to staff,
and/or schedule requests for consideration at a subsequent meeting.

CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed on the Consent Calendar are considered routine. The City Council may act on
these items by one motion following public comment. Only Councilmembers may pull an item from
the Consent Calendar for discussion, reading of resolutions and ordinances will be waived.
3.  ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING THE CITY WARRANT REGISTER
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, ALLOWING
  CERTAIN CLAIMS AND DEMANDS AND SPECIFYING THE FUNDS OUT
  OF WHICH THE SAME ARE TO BE PAID, dated July 18, 2024.
  Attachment(s):  Resolution Approving City Warrant Register Dated July 18, 2024

4.  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES OF JULY 9, 2024 (REGULAR)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council approve the regular City Council meeting
  minutes of July 9, 2024.
  Attachment(s):  Draft Regular Meeting Minutes of July 9, 2024

5.  SECOND READING  AND  ADOPTION  OF  AN  ORDINANCE INCREASING  CITY
  COUNCILMEMBER COMPENSATION TO $1,275 PER  MONTH IN ACCORDANCE  WITH
  SENATE BILL 329 (FUNDING SOURCE: GENERAL FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council waive further reading and adopt AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT,
  CALIFORNIA, APPROVING A STATUTORY INCREASE IN COMPENSATION
  FOR MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL TO TAKE EFFECT AFTER THE
  NOVEMBER 2024 MUNICIPAL ELECTION.
  Attachment(s):  Ordinance Increasing City Council Compensation

6.  INVESTMENT REPORT - QUARTER ENDING JUNE 30, 2024
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council receive and accept the Investment Report
  for the quarter ending June 30, 2024.
 Page 5  City Council Agenda  July 23, 2024

  Attachment(s):  Quarterly Investment Report

7.  AWARD OF CONTRACT TO TJKM TRANSPORTATION CONSULTANTS FOR THE
  DEVELOPMENT OF A CITYWIDE STREET SIGN PROGRAM (FUNDING SOURCE:
  AMERICAN RESCUE PLAN ACT FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council award a contract to TJKM Transportation
  Consultants for the Citywide Street Sign Program and authorize the City
  Manager to enter into a contract in the amount of $238,193.56.
8.  AUTHORIZATION TO ENTER INTO A CONTRACT WITH RON’S MAINTENANCE FOR
  STORM DRAIN CATCH BASIN DEBRIS REMOVAL SERVICES (FUNDING SOURCE:
  SEWER FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council authorize the City Manager to enter into a
  five-year contract with Ron's Maintenance for storm drain catch basin debris
  removal services in an amount not to exceed $23,600 per year.
9.  AUTHORIZATION TO AMEND THE PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH
  4LEAF, INC. FOR PROFESSIONAL BUILDING DIVISION SERVICES (FUNDING SOURCE:
  GENERAL FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute an
  amendment to the existing professional services agreement with 4LEAF, Inc.
  extending the term to June 30, 2025, with an optional one-year extension,
  and increasing compensation by $75,000, for a total contract amount of
  $280,000.
10. ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING SUBMITTAL OF THE FISCAL YEAR
  2023-24 TRANSPORTATION DEVELOPMENT ACT - ARTICLE 4, STATE TRANSIT
  ASSISTANCE, SENATE BILL 1 STATE TRANSIT ASSISTANCE, AND SENATE BILL 1
  STATE OF GOOD REPAIR CLAIM FORMS TO RESERVE TRANSIT CAPITAL FUNDS FOR
  FUTURE USE TO FUND THE CLAREMONT DIAL-A-RIDE SERVICE (FUNDING SOURCE:
  TRANSPORTATION FUNDS)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, AUTHORIZING
  THE SUBMITAL OF 2023-24 TRANSPORTATION DEVELOPMENT ACT
  ARTICLE 4, STATE TRANSIT ASSISTANCE, SENATE BILL 1 STATE
  TRANSIT ASSISTANCE, AND SENATE BILL 1 STATE OF GOOD REPAIR
  CLAIM FORMS TO RESERVE FUNDS FOR FUTURE CAPITAL USE.
  Attachment(s):  Resolution Authorizing Submittal

11. THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA - CALIFORNIA HIGHWAY PATROL (CHP) CANNABIS TAX
  FUND GRANT PROGRAM (FUNDING SOURCE: CHP CANNABIS GRANT)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING
  PARTICIPATION IN THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA - CALIFORNIA HIGHWAY
  PATROL (CHP) CANNABIS TAX FUND GRANT.
  Attachment(s):  CTFGP Grant Resolution
 Page 6  City Council Agenda  July 23, 2024

12. AWARD OF CONTRACT TO FRITTS FORD FOR VEHICLE REPLACEMENTS (FUNDING
  SOURCE: MOTOR FLEET)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council award a contract to Fritts Ford in the
  amount of $619,354.77 for the purchase of ten new vehicles, and authorize
  the City Manager to execute the contract.
13. AUTHORIZATION TO ENTER INTO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT  FOR  PENDING
  SETTLEMENT IN NATIONAL PRESCRIPTION OPIATE LITIGATION
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council:
  A. Approve the City of Claremont's participation in the Kroger Settlement;
  B. Authorize the City Manager to execute a settlement agreement (which may
  be titled a "participating agreement") and any other agreements or
  documents necessary to effectuate that approval; and
  C. Authorize the City Manager to elect that the City receive settlement funds
  directly.
14. RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING THE FILING OF AN APPLICATION FOR A SAFE STREETS
  AND ROADS FOR ALL (SS4A) GRANT WITH THE U.S. DEPARTMENT OF
  TRANSPORTATION FOR THE INDIAN HILL BOULEVARD AND SAN JOSE AVENUE
  COMPLEMENTARY CORRIDOR SAFETY PLAN
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, AUTHORIZING
  THE FILING OF AN APPLICATION FOR A SAFE STREETS AND ROADS
  FOR  ALL  (SS4A)  GRANT  WITH  THE  U.S. DEPARTMENT  OF
  TRANSPORTATION FOR THE INDIAN HILL BOULEVARD AND SAN JOSE
  AVENUE COMPLEMENTARY CORRIDOR SAFETY PLAN.
  Attachment(s):  SS4A - Resolution 2024

15. AUTHORIZATION TO ENTER INTO A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH
  AGINGNEXT, INC. FOR PROFESSIONAL CASE MANAGEMENT SERVICES (FUNDING
  SOURCES: CDBG FUND AND GENERAL FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council authorize the City Manager to enter into
  an agreement with AgingNext, Inc. for professional case management
  services for a term of one year in an amount not to exceed $35,120, with the
  option to extend the agreement on an annual basis for four additional
  one-year terms until June 30, 2029. Additionally, if the agreement is
  extended, the compensation will be increased at an amount commensurate
  with the April-April Consumer Price Index (CPI), not to exceed three percent
  each year.
 Page 7  City Council Agenda  July 23, 2024

16. AUTHORIZATION TO ACCEPT OLDER AMERICAN ACT FUNDS FOR THE  SENIOR
  NUTRITION PROGRAM 2024-2028 (FUNDING SOURCE: OLDER AMERICANS ACT)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council authorize the City Manager to enter into
  an agreement with the County of Los Angeles for the acceptance of Older
  American Act funds for the Senior Nutrition Program for a term of one year,
  with the option for three additional one-year terms.

PUBLIC HEARINGS - None

ORDINANCES - None

ADMINISTRATIVE ITEM
17. BUDGET AMENDMENT FOR THE AMERICAN RESCUE PLAN ACT FUNDED GOSGV
  SUBSIDY (FUNDING SOURCE: AMERICAN RESCUE PLAN ACT FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council:
  A. Authorize the City Manager to amend the existing agreement with
  ActiveSGV to increase the compensation by $168,000 for a total agreement
  amount of $228,000 for GoSGV e-bike subsidies; and
  B. Appropriate $168,000 from the American Rescue Plan Act Fund to
  increase the GoSGV Program subsidy funding.

CONTINUED PUBLIC COMMENT
This time is reserved for those persons who were unable to speak earlier in the agenda because
of the 30-minute time restriction.

COMMISSIONS

ADJOURNMENT

THE REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS OF AUGUST 13, 2024 AND AUGUST 27, 2024 HAVE
BEEN CANCELLED.

THE NEXT REGULAR MEETING OF THE CLAREMONT CITY COUNCIL WILL BE HELD ON,
SEPTEMBER 10, 2024, AT 6:30 PM, IN THE CLAREMONT COUNCIL CHAMBER, 225 WEST
SECOND STREET, CLAREMONT, CA 91711.
